jobs.title: Junior AI Developer
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a motivated and technically curious AI Developer with 1\-2 years of experience to join our development team. The candidate will work on AI\-powered applications involving Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, AI agents, APIs, embeddings, vector search, automation, data processing, and SQL/database operations.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in Python, SQL, APIs, and AI/ML concepts, along with good problem\-solving ability and an interest in building practical enterprise AI solutions.

The candidate will work closely with developers, architects, business analysts, QA engineers, and project teams to design, build, test, and improve AI\-enabled applications and integrations.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Develop AI\-powered applications using Python and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Build and integrate Generative AI solutions using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or similar LLM APIs.
* Develop AI agents and tool\-calling workflows that can interact with APIs, databases, documents, and external systems.
* Design and implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Generate and manage embeddings and implement semantic/vector search using suitable vector databases or search services.
* Create and optimize prompts, structured outputs, and AI workflows for reliable and consistent responses.
* Develop and integrate REST APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
* Write SQL queries and perform database operations using SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar relational databases.
* Process structured and unstructured data using Python, Pandas, JSON, CSV, Excel, and document\-processing libraries.
* Build AI workflows for document extraction, classification, summarization, validation, and decision support.
* Develop automation workflows by integrating AI services with enterprise applications and external systems.
* Test AI responses for accuracy, relevance, hallucination, edge cases, and overall reliability.
* Debug and troubleshoot Python applications, APIs, databases, AI integrations, and data\-processing issues.
* Maintain source code using Git, GitHub, or Azure DevOps and follow standard development practices.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation for APIs, prompts, workflows, integrations, and implemented AI solutions.
* Collaborate with project teams to understand business requirements and convert them into practical AI solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 1\-2 years of relevant experience in AI/ML, Python development, Generative AI, or software development involving AI solutions.
* Strong programming fundamentals in Python and working knowledge of SQL.
* Practical understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, API integrations, and backend services.
* Exposure to AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks is desirable.
* Working knowledge of relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
* Familiarity with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Postman, and standard software development workflows.
* Exposure to Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Docker, cloud deployment, or AI automation tools is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, learning, and documentation skills.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kovilpatti, Tamil Nadu 628502: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 1–2 years of relevant hands\-on experience in Python, AI/ML, Generative AI, or AI\-based software development?
* Are you start immediately? If not pls specify notice period
* Do you have a personal laptop?

Work Location: In person

Conversion: Performance during the internship is reviewed at the end of the term. Strong performers are


converted to a full\-time role at Arcitech AI; this is not automatic and is assessed against the same bar as our


full\-time hires for this function.


Prior project experience (academic, personal, freelance, hackathon, or open\-source) directly relevant to this


role is required to be considered — we are not hiring purely on academic credentials with no applied work to


show.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


Arcitech AI is looking for a Python AI/ML Developer Intern to work alongside our AI/ML engineering team on


real LLM\-powered features — think RAG pipelines, prompt\-driven workflows, and integrations with LLM APIs


— not isolated notebook exercises. Strong performers over the 3\-month term will be considered for a full\-time


Python Developer (AI/ML) role.


This is a specialized track: we expect you to already have hands\-on exposure to at least one ML/LLM project


— a model you trained, a RAG pipeline you built, or an LLM API you integrated into something real. We will


deepen your depth in our stack (LangChain, vector databases, FastAPI); we are not starting from AI/ML


fundamentals.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Assist in building LLM\-powered workflows and RAG pipelines using LangChain, under the guidance of a


senior AI/ML engineer.


* Work with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI) and help implement and test prompt


strategies.


* Get hands\-on with embedding models and vector search — help implement or maintain similarity\-search


components (pgvector, FAISS, or similar).


* Support model experimentation using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers on assigned


tasks.


* Build and maintain small Python microservices using FastAPI to expose AI features.


* Write tests for AI service code (pytest) and follow our Git and code\-review workflow.


* Own one small, well\-scoped AI feature or pipeline component end\-to\-end during the internship, as a


basis for your conversion evaluation.


**Qualifications**
------------------


* Pursuing or completed a Bachelor\&\#39;s or Master\&\#39;s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.


* 0–1 years of professional experience — internships, coursework, and self\-driven projects all count.


* Mandatory: at least one AI/ML or LLM project — a fine\-tuned or trained model, a RAG pipeline, an LLM\-


API\-integrated application, or a similar applied project. Coursework alone without an applied build does


not qualify. Applications without a demonstrable project will not be considered.


**Skills**
----------


* Working knowledge of Python (3\.9\+).


* Some hands\-on exposure to PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers.


* Basic understanding of how LLMs and embeddings work; bonus if you\&\#39;ve used an LLM API (OpenAI,


Anthropic, etc.) in a project.


* Some exposure to LangChain, or a clear ability to learn it quickly.


* Basic understanding of REST APIs; some exposure to FastAPI or Flask is a plus.


* Strong analytical thinking and comfort with ambiguity — AI/ML work often doesn\&\#39;t have a single right


answer.


* Clear communication — able to explain your model/pipeline choices and trade\-offs.


**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Exposure to a vector database (pgvector, Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Milvus).


* Any experience with prompt engineering or evaluating LLM outputs.


* Exposure to Docker.


* Kaggle competitions, published notebooks, or open\-source ML contributions.


Other Details


This is a 3\-month, on\-site internship based at our Vashi, Navi Mumbai office. You will be mentored directly by


our AI/ML engineering team.


Please include a link to your GitHub, a notebook, or a clear write\-up of your AI/ML project(s) with your


application — this is required for shortlisting.


Performance is evaluated against depth of understanding, ownership, and code quality, not just task


completion.


**Compensation**
----------------


Stipend Range: ₹1,20,000 – ₹1,80,000 per annum (approx. ₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month), based on skill


assessment during the interview

This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to build core DevOps skills while getting direct exposure to the infrastructure that powers Generative AI and Agentic AI applications.
